description: Heavy rainfall begins across central Kerala. IMD issues orange alert.
Pampa river level rises 2.4m above danger mark. Downstream villages on alert.
NH-66 near Alappuzha submerged. Road access to coastal areas cut off.
Alappuzha Medical Center requests immediate evacuation support. Generator fuel critical.
Idukki reservoir reaches 99.2% capacity. Controlled release initiated.
NDRF rescue boat deployed from Kottayam base. 3 teams mobilised.
Alappuzha Relief Shelter reaches 80% capacity. Overflow protocol activated.
Red alert issued for Thrissur and Palakkad districts. Rainfall exceeds 20cm/hr.
Kottayam–Ernakulam highway blocked by landslide debris. Supply routes disrupted.
Kottayam District Hospital ICU flooding. Immediate patient transfer required.
Ernakulam Resource Center dispatches 12 relief kits and 2 water tankers.
Thrissur Shelter Hub at 95% capacity. Requesting additional tents and supplies.
Flash flood warning: Pathanamthitta district. 3 villages submerged. Mass evacuation ordered.
Coast Guard helicopter deployed for aerial rescue over flooded coastal belt.
Palakkad Supply Depot activates emergency protocol. Army convoy en route.
IMD upgrades to Red Alert statewide. Rainfall forecast 35cm in next 6 hours.
